description: Generate authentic poetic Chinese names rooted in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), Songs of Chu (Chuci), and Tang Poetry, balanced by Five Elements (Wu Xing) and surname.

favorableElement.description: Target Five Element (Yong Shen) to strengthen in the name (default: Water)

surname.description: Optional Chinese surname (e.g. "林", "苏", "陈", "李", default: "林")

name: generate_poetic_chinese_name
